info.title: Umbraco SBOM Tool
info.description: Generate a CycloneDX 1.6 XML SBOM for a NuGet, npm, or Terraform project. Drop-in replacement for the dotnet CycloneDX and @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm tools used in CI pipelines, with layered license resolution (registry metadata → maintained override list) and an embedded SPDX license-override list curated for Umbraco's dependency surface (System.*, Microsoft.Extensions.*, hashicorp/*, …).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generate a CycloneDX 1.6 XML SBOM for a NuGet, npm, or Terraform project.

options.name: --output-file
options.description:
Path where the SBOM file is written. Default: ./sbom.xml
in the current working directory.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Print the tool version and exit.
Exit codes:
0    Success — every component fully resolved.
10   Success-with-warnings — at least one component has unknown license or unresolved status.
20   Schema validation failure — no output written.
30   Embedded override list failed startup validation — no output written.
40   No recognized manifests at the project path.
41   Mixed-ecosystem path — markers for multiple ecosystems present.
1    Unhandled error.

arguments.name: PROJECT_PATH
arguments.description:
Path to a project file (e.g., a .csproj or package.json) or a
directory containing the project's manifests.
